 "rationale": "A PMOS input cannot work at VCM=0.9 V because |Vth| is about 1 V, so the input pair is NMOS. The PMOS CS stage copies the OTA load's gm/Id and L, so it is current-matched at balance, which gives near-zero systematic offset. The inverter restores rail-to-rail swing. Budget: 10 uA ref + 60 uA preamp + 20 uA second stage = 90 uA (162 uW). Preamp current is spent to lower R*C at the high-impedance node, giving about 2 ns. The output stage slews in under 1 ns."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (15.0, 8.0, 20.0),     # input pair gm/Id
    "L_in":    (0.5, 0.15, 1.5),      # input pair L
    "I1":      (60e-6, 20e-6, 70e-6), # preamp tail current
    "I2":      (20e-6, 8e-6, 30e-6),  # second-stage current
    "gmid_p":  (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),     # PMOS load / CS gm/Id (must match for zero offset)
    "L_p":     (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),      # PMOS load / CS L
    "L_t":     (1.0, 0.3, 2.0),       # NMOS current-mirror L
    "Wn_inv":  (1.5, 0.42, 4.0),      # inverter nfet width
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 50e-15)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vod = spec.get("vod", 0.01)
    I1, I2 = p["I1"], p["I2"]

    # PMOS diode load of the OTA (vds = vgs)
    ld = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], I1 / 2, vds=1.0)
    ld = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], I1 / 2, vds=ld.vgs)
    vd = vdd - ld.vgs                      # OTA drain nodes at balance

    # Input pair, with body effect on the source node
    vs = 0.25
    for _ in range(3):
        inp = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], I1 / 2,
                       vds=max(vd - vs, 0.1), vsb=max(vs, 0.0))
        vs = vcm - inp.vgs

    # NMOS bias mirrors driven by the ibias diode
    ref = lut.size("n", 10, p["L_t"], iref, vds=0.7)
    ref = lut.size("n", 10, p["L_t"], iref, vds=ref.vgs)
    tail = lut.size("n", 10, p["L_t"], I1, vds=max(vs, 0.1))
    snk = lut.size("n", 10, p["L_t"], I2, vds=0.9)

    # PMOS CS second stage: same gm/Id and L as the load, so current-matched at balance
    p2 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], I2, vds=0.9)

    # Inverter
    Wn = p["Wn_inv"]
    Wp = 3.0 * Wn
    Linv = 0.15

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", ref)
    n.dev("MTAIL", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", tail)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", inp)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", inp)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", ld)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", ld)
    n.dev("M5", "o2", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", p2)
    n.dev("M6", "o2", "ibias", "vss", "vss", snk)
    n.M("MINVN", "vout", "o2", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Linv)
    n.M("MINVP", "vout", "o2", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Linv)

    # ---- predictions ----
    # Stage 1: high-impedance node o1, single-pole R*C with partial Miller from M5
    gout1 = inp.gds + ld.gds
    gain1 = inp.gm / gout1
    gain2 = p2.gm / (p2.gds + snk.gds)
    C1 = p2.cgg + inp.cdd + ld.cdd + 0.3 * gain2 * p2.cgd
    t1 = 0.69 * C1 / gout1

    # Stage 2: slews the inverter input through about VDD/2
    Cinv = (Wn + Wp) * Linv * 9e-15 + (Wn + Wp) * 0.6e-15
    C2 = p2.cdd + snk.cdd + Cinv
    t2 = C2 * 0.9 / I2

    # Inverter driving CL (strong devices, roughly 150 uA/um saturated average)
    t3 = (cl + 2e-15) * 0.9 / (150e-6 * Wn)

    tpd = t1 + t2 + t3
    power = vdd * (iref + I1 + I2)
    offset = 0.9 / (gain1 * gain2) + 1e-3  # residual + mirror vds mismatch allowance
    pol = 1 if gain1 * gain2 * vod > 0.9 else 0

    return n, {"tpd": tpd, "power": power, "offset": offset, "polarity_ok": pol}
